purpose: Teach: 今年度/小規模/品目/原価/正社員/商社/同年/定例

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業、本気で、絶対、今年度、絶対、節目、絶対、迎えるなあ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Father, you pushed this company toward its founding milestone with absolute seriousness, and I ask that we honor that commitment this year.
lines.style: Measured, quiet authority. Opens on a grounded breath. Voice carries the weight of generational responsibility. Deliberate pacing. Each phrase settles before the next one lands. Slight pause before the final clause—not a plea, but a solemn charge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、小規模、絶対、事業も、絶対、大事に、絶対、してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your time, we have cherished the foundation you built—this small-scale business and its values. I carry your seriousness forward, and I am grateful.
lines.style: Direct, composed gratitude. Clear-eyed respect without performance. Steady eye contact maintained through the line. Voice neither elevated nor diminished. Each commitment stated as fact, not aspiration. Warm undertone beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、初期、絶対、品目、絶対、五つから、絶対、始めたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Father, you started us with five core products, chosen with absolute care, and that foundation remains everything.
lines.style: Nostalgic, almost reverent. Softer attack than before. Voice draws back slightly, as if looking into the past. Gentle but firm conviction. Trailing off on the final phrase—not weakening, but letting the memory settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、原価、絶対、にこだわった、絶対、姿勢、絶対、忘れません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your particular care about cost, about every choice—that stance has never left us. It shapes how we work even now, and I am grateful.
lines.style: Reflective, almost meditative. Slower pace than before. Warm regard for the memory beneath each word. Voice carries the weight of ongoing practice, not just memory. Small pause before 'even now'—acknowledgment of continuance across time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、若い社員、絶対、正社員、絶対、登用、絶対、推進したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Father, you championed the young people who came through those years—employees born in your same generation—and you treated them like family.
lines.style: Nostalgic, tender. Voice opens with admiration for this specific memory. Slightly warmer tone than previous lines. Pace slows on the names of those people. Trailing off on 'family'—the weight of that care still present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、大手、絶対、商社、絶対、と、絶対、築いた、絶対、信頼、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The trust you built with the major trading companies—those relationships continue to hold steady. The work you did then sustains us now, and I am grateful.
lines.style: Steady, affirming. Voice carries continuity rather than nostalgia. Each phrase states fact, not longing. Slightly fuller tone on the names of those partnerships. Final clause delivered with quiet certainty—not emotion, but unshakeable respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、私と、絶対、同年、絶対、生まれの、絶対、社員、絶対、可愛がってたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Father, you showed real affection to the colleagues who came of age with you—those people knew they mattered to you, and that changed them.
lines.style: Tender, specific memory. Voice softens noticeably on 'real affection'—this detail moves him. Pace slows. Almost conversational warmth beneath the formal register. Trailing quality on the final phrase—recognition that some care carries forward beyond measure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、定例、絶対、訓話、絶対、社員、絶対、楽しみにしておりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. They looked forward to your regular talks—those moments taught them what good leadership truly means. That inheritance lives in them still, and I am grateful for what you gave.
lines.style: Warm closing. Slower, more breathful pacing. Voice carries finality and peace—this is the gathered sum of a lifetime. Slight lift on 'what you gave'—not sentimental, but acknowledging the irreplaceable nature of that gift. Settles into quietness.
